added.summary: Data tables: an `.ogt` of `type table` holds a game's items, abilities, recipes, loot or waves as `row "id" { ... }`, read as one of the game's components with og.table.load (cooked) or og.table.parse (text), field by field, all or nothing, a refusal naming the table, line, row and field. og cook checks every id is there once, every `asset "path"` exists and every `row "table" "id"` names a row; `text "key" "Base"` fields join og.i18n and `og i18n extract`. A row is held in the world as a TableRow field (a 52-bit handle of its table and id) that names the same row after a reload or in a save; og.table.get reads its values, og.table.name its id and og.table.missing every field still holding a deleted row. Guide: `og api show data`.
